scope: Aidreamcapes English homepage; copy and workflow review
findingsBefore: Several visual buttons were spans, so apparent controls had no action.
New modules did not carry a selected scene or brief into the workspace.
Some phrases described automatic chat, exact delivery or performance more strongly than the current workflow supports.
The comparison table used vague labels and duplicated a plan price instead of explaining the production choice.
copyChanges: Descriptive English product headings identify AI product videos, product photos, scene templates, AI presenters and batch drafts.
Calls to action name the actual next destination, including Browse templates, Use this brief, Open Batch Drafts and Create a product image.
The process now follows product assets, scene/presenter, brief, saved draft/storyboard, selected shot generation/assembly, and review/download.
Comparison copy explains concrete choices without claims about guaranteed sales or creator performance.
Illustrative draft cards remain examples and create form prefills; they never impersonate existing customer tasks.
seoChecks: Content remains complete server-rendered HTML owned by current LivePage.contentJson.
One descriptive H1; structured headings; contextual anchor links with href; descriptive image alt text.
Title, meta description and WebPage JSON-LD are updated together; canonical remains https://www.aivideosugc.com/.
Private workspace routes retain noindex behavior; no public copy or navigation API fetch added.
conversionAssessment: Clearer next steps and form prefills reduce ambiguity and repeat typing. A conversion-rate increase has not been measured; it requires observed user behavior or an A/B test.
language: English source; browser translation remains available.
